title: Butterflied Leg of Lamb
headnote: The marinade comes from an old handwritten index card in the family files titled “Pecks Lamb”: lemon, fresh ginger, garlic, onion, oil, and warm curry spices.

items.raw: 1 boneless butterflied leg of lamb, 4–5 pounds
¼ to ⅓ cup fresh lemon juice
2-inch piece fresh ginger, peeled and chopped — or 2 teaspoons ground ginger
4 to 6 (torn off the card) garlic cloves — or ¾ teaspoon garlic powder
3 teaspoons curry powder — or turmeric, coriander, and cumin to make 3 teaspoons
Cinnamon and mace, about ¼ teaspoon each — no amounts on the card
gaps: about ¼ teaspoon each — no amounts on the card

steps.text: Purée the lemon juice, ginger, garlic, and onion in a blender until smooth. Add the oil and all the spices and blend again.
Open the lamb flat on a board. Where it is much thicker than the rest, make shallow cuts and fold the meat open so it is roughly 1½ to 2 inches thick all over. Trim any thick seams of fat.
Rub the marinade over both sides and refrigerate 3 to 4 hours (the card says “3/4 hrs”). Take it out 45 minutes before cooking.
Prepare a two-zone fire: one side medium-high, the other low or off. Clean and oil the grates.
Scrape off the excess marinade and grill over the hot side 5 to 6 minutes per side, until well browned. The onion and spices char quickly, so watch for flare-ups.
Move to the cooler side, cover, and cook until the thickest part reads 130°F for medium-rare, 10 to 20 minutes more. The thin parts will be more done, which suits a crowd with different tastes.
Rest 10 to 15 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.

notes.label: Oven method
notes.text: roast on a rack in a 425°F oven for 30 to 40 minutes to 130°F, then run it under the broiler 2 to 3 minutes for color.

notes.label: Skewers help
notes.text: two long skewers run crosswise through the meat keep it flat and make it easy to flip.

notes.label: Alongside
notes.text: Grandma’s Mint Jelly (Chapter 12), the roast potatoes, and the orange and fennel salad.

openQuestion: Who is Peck (or Beck)? The card’s left edge is torn off, so the number of garlic cloves is missing, and the card has no method — I filled in a standard one. Is this the marinade for the butterflied leg, and is it grilled or roasted?
